audit: Jigsaw's guide moved to /pages/size-guide (old /help/size-guide 404s). Jigsaw publishes inches only, keyed by UK 6-18; cm = inches x 2.54 rounded to 0.1, inch originals in _in (bust, waist, hip at fullest). No US/EU for clothing, so removed. Letter sizes are not stored: the chart's letter header spans XS over UK 6-8 and S over UK 10 only, while Jigsaw's own size filters group S = UK 8-10 and M = 12-14, so the letter mapping is ambiguous. Old entry was letter-based with XS = UK 8 (official UK 8 is 33/25.5/36 in = 83.8/64.8/91.4 cm vs old 83/63/88) and had no UK 6 or 18.
